paper_metadata.title: Chameleon: Mixed-Modal Early-Fusion Foundation Models
paper_metadata.abstract: We present Chameleon, a family of early-fusion token-based mixed-modal models capable of understanding and generating images and text in any arbitrary sequence. We outline a stable training approach from inception, an alignment recipe, and an architectural parameterization tailored for the early-fusion, token-based, mixed-modal setting. The models are evaluated on a comprehensive range of tasks, including visual question answering, image captioning, text generation, image generation, and long-form mixed modal generation. Chameleon demonstrates broad and general capabilities, including state-of-the-art performance in image captioning tasks, outperforms Llama-2 in text-only tasks while being competitive with models such as Mixtral 8x7B and Gemini-Pro, and performs non-trivial image generation, all in a single model. It also matches or exceeds the performance of much larger models, including Gemini Pro and GPT-4V, according to human judgments on a new long-form mixed-modal generation evaluation, where either the prompt or outputs contain mixed sequences of both images and text. Chameleon marks a significant step forward in a unified modeling of full multimodal documents.

extraction_data.innovation: Early-fusion architecture that converts 512x512 images into 1024 discrete tokens via an 8192-size codebook, mixing them with text in a unified 65,536-vocab BPE tokenizer; two-stage pre-training (80% unsupervised, 20% higher-quality + instruction tuning); QK-norm and dropout to stabilize training and prevent softmax logit drift/norm divergence across modalities.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: LLaMA-2 and CodeLLaMa pre-training data (2.9T tokens), publicly available and licensed web sources (1.4B text-image pairs, 1.5T tokens), interleaved text-image data (400B tokens), higher-quality datasets, and instruction tuning sets
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning for alignment, Supervised fine-tuning for multi-modal tasks
extraction_data.research_problem: Unified modeling of full multimodal documents; mixed-modal reasoning and generation.
extraction_data.application: Text generation, image captioning, visual question-answering, commonsense reasoning, mathematics, world knowledge
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Chameleon-SFT (Text, Code, Visual Chat, Image Generation, Interleaved Generation, Safety), Instruction tuning sets, Multi-task fine-tuning data, task-specific fine-tuning data
extraction_data.tokenizer: Custom image tokenizer (1024 discrete tokens per 512x512 image, codebook size 8192)
extraction_data.hardware_description: Meta's Research Super Cluster (RSC) with NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand; internal research cluster with Elastic Fabric
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Standard transformer attention with query-key normalization, Multi-head attention with Query-Key normalization (QK-Norm)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: End-to-end pre-training on interleaved mixed-modal data -> supervised fine-tuning for alignment
extraction_data.safety_evaluation_protocol: Manual curation of safety prompts for safety tuning
extraction_data.safety_defect_rate: Crowdsourced (7B): Safe 99.2%, Unsafe 0.4%, Unsure 0.4%; Crowdsourced (34B): Safe 99.7%, Unsafe 0.1%, Unsure 0.2%; Red Team (34B): Safe 93.9%, Unsafe 1.6%, Unsure 4.5%
extraction_data.vision_encoder: Discrete image tokens (quantized images), Discrete image tokenizer (codebook size 8192, 512x512 input -> 1024 tokens), Unified early-fusion tokens
extraction_data.optimizer_innovation: z-loss regularization (regularizing the partition function Z of the softmax function by adding 10^-5 log^2 Z to the loss)
extraction_data.benchmark_result: VQA and image captioning SOTA; matches Mixtral 8x7B and Gemini-Pro on text-only benchmarks; 60.4% preference rate vs Gemini-Pro, 51.6% vs GPT-4V on long-form mixed-modal generation; GSM8k (SFT): 50.9 (7B), 77.0 (34B); MATH: 12.9 (7B), 24.7 (34B); MMLU: 52.1 (7B), 65.8 (34B); PIQA: 57.0/63.3; SIQA: 74.2/82.7; HellaSwag: 75.6/85.1; WinoGrande: 76.1/84.1; Arc-E: 46.5/59.7; Arc-C: 51.0/54.0; BoolQ: 81.4/86.0; Chameleon vs. Gemini win rate 69.1%; Chameleon vs. GPT-4V win rate 61.7%
extraction_data.weight_clipping_mechanism: Global gradient clipping at a threshold of 1.0
